name: ts-hexagram-generator
description: Yijing hexagram oracle (yarrow stalk method) — Turborepo + pnpm workspaces root
author: Lim Jiechao <jiechao.lim@gmail.com>

scripts.check:affected: turbo run format:check lint:check type:check test build --affected --concurrency=100% --log-order=grouped
scripts.check:all: turbo run format:check lint:check type:check test build --force --concurrency=100% --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:flake: turbo run test --force && turbo run test --force && turbo run test --force && turbo run test --force && turbo run test --force
scripts.test:stress: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n a,b,c,d --max-processes 4 'pnpm test:flake' 'pnpm test:flake' 'pnpm test:flake' 'pnpm test:flake'
scripts.test:stress:once: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n a,b,c,d --max-processes 4 'pnpm test' 'pnpm test' 'pnpm test' 'pnpm test'
